translated: Where the Neckar winds through forests, meadows and orchards, where castles, half-timbered places and gentle hills shape the view – this is where it lies: the Neckartal-Odenwald Nature Park. Between Heidelberg, Mosbach and Hardheim, our nature park combines nature, culture and enjoyment. Here you can hike, cycle and experience regional diversity – in a landscape that breathes history and shapes the future. With heart and responsibility we are committed to the preservation of this unique cultural landscape – in the flow between man and nature, today and tomorrow.
